name: agent-fleet-cc
description: Agent skills: codex (delegate to the Codex CLI) and imagine (image generation)

scripts.check:devdeps: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('node_modules/.bin/tsc') || (console.error('typescript is not installed here (a fresh git worktree has no node_modules). Run: npm ci'), process.exit(1))"
scripts.test: npm run test:structure && npm run test:codex && npm run test:imagine && npm run test:e2e
scripts.prebuild:codex: npm run check:devdeps && mkdir -p skills/codex/.generated/app-server-types && codex app-server generate-ts --out skills/codex/.generated/app-server-types
